children: CISO Global's revenue fell 13% year over year, while earnings shifted from income to a loss. The decline reflected lower security managed services revenue, primarily from losing several higher-revenue customers, partly offset by new engagements; cybersecurity software revenue grew as licenses increased. A goodwill impairment charge and the absence of the prior-year convertible-note extinguishment gain also weighed on results.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue decreased 15%, primarily due to the loss of several higher-revenue customers, partly offset by new engagements.
: Revenue increased 37%, primarily due to increased software licenses.
: Revenue decreased 4%, primarily due to fewer customer projects.
: Payroll costs fell 13% due primarily to headcount reductions; SG&A declined 7%, primarily on lower payroll, amortization and credit card fees.
: Recorded a $1.7M impairment charge after the reporting unit's fair value fell below its carrying amount.
